docs.title: Commands List
docs.text:
Below is a list of all relevant commands for the addonpack.

Note, not all of these commands are accessible without cheats enabled / Operator rights.

docs.title: Superpower Commands:
docs.text:
/superpower add fsang:powername @

  • This command can be used to add powers to any player. Just replace the @ with the name of the player.

/superpower query @

  • This command can be used to list any / all powers a player has. Just replace the @ with the name of the player.

/superpower remove fsang:powername @

  • This command can be used to remove powers from any player. Just replace the @ with the name of the player.

/superpower replace fsang:powername fsang:powername @

  • This command can be used to replace powers from any player. Just replace the @ with the name of the player.

/superpower set fsang:powername @

  • This command can be used to set powers from any player, erasing all others. Just replace the @ with the name of the player.

/ability unlock @s fsang:power_name all

  • This command can unlock every ability for the power you have, just replace the power_name with the name of the power you have.

/ability lock @s fsang:power_name all

  • This command can lock every ability for the power you have, just replace the power_name with the name of the power you have.

docs.title: FSang Skill Point Commands
docs.text:
/FSang.EXP set @s #

  • This command sets your Exp to whatever you replace # with.

/FSang.Level set @s #

  • This command sets your Level to whatever you replace # with. Max level 50.

/FSang.SkillPoints set @s #

  • This command sets your Skill Points to whatever you replace # with.

docs.title: FSang Gamerule Commands
docs.text:
/gamerule FsangItemCooldown true

  • Enables the cooldown timer to swap powers (not including symbiotes)

/gamerule FsangItemCooldown

  • Disables the cooldown timer to swap powers (not including symbiotes)

/gamerule FsangSymbiote Cooldown true

  • Enables the cooldown timer to swap symbiotes

/gamerule FsangSymbiote Cooldown false

  • Disables the cooldown timer to swap symbiotes

/gamerule FsangStrongPunch false

  • Disables the Strong Punch shockwave effect.

/gamerule FsangStrongPunchDamage #

  • This command sets your Strong Punch Shockwave to kick in whatever you replace the # with it.

docs.title: Skill Point System
docs.text:
Skill Points System are how you upgrade your powers in the power menu. You gain Skill Points via;

  • Gain SP Xp on kills, gaining xp on kills are target's Max Health/10 EXP
  • Buying 1 Skill Point with 60 Minecraft Level
  • Get 1 Skill Point by using Skill Catalyst
  • Gain 2 SP Xp by using your abilities, 10 uses for each ability after 5 minute cooldown per ability
  • Gain 1 SP Xp every 2 minute passively

Related Information

  • The Skill Points and Levels are not transferred between power. Every power starts with Level 1 and 1 Skill Point
  • Max Level for a power is 50. You can't gain more Skill Points via Level System once you reached max level except for buying them with vanilla levels or via catalyst.
  • Buying Skill Points with Vanilla Levels does not change your Level.
  • Getting Skill Points with Skill Catalyst does not change your Level.
  • Skill Catalysts are a potion that can be crafted used any filled power syringe. You brew them with 1 Filled Power Syringe and Regeneration inside of Brewing Stand .You must have the effect for at least 1 full minute to gain the Free Skill Point. After using this, there will be a 5 minute cooldown before you can use another one. Current ways to get Skill Catalyst effects are;
    • Potion of Skill Catalyst
    • Splash Potion of Skill Catalyst
    • Lingering Potion of Skill Catalyst

    • Arrow of Skill Catalyst

      * Filled Power Syringes are obtained with right clicking a empty syringe while having any Main Power. You are sacrificing a Power for Skill Points.

docs.text:
The Iron Spider (Model I - Miles) is crafted in the Tailoring Table with 2 Gold Circuits, 2 Diamond Circuits, a Template II suitset, 8 Reinforced Black Fabric, 4 Reinforced Red Fabric, 1 Advanced Web Shooter and the Iron Spider Model I - Miles blueprint. The armor can be repaired in an anvil with Stark Repair Kits.

Stats:

  • Armor Rating: 28
  • Armor Toughness: 8
  • Base Attack Damage: +2
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Repulsor Beam" - Fire a continuous beam of repulsor energy that deals damage on hit that can be held for 10 seconds before needing to recharge. This armor has an adjustable repulsor damage output up to a max of 4 that can be adjusted by crouching and using the ability key:
    • Output 1 - 5 damage
    • Output 2 - 8 damage
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Waldoe Control" - Open up your waldoes to use your waldo related abilities. After enabling them you can use the following abilities in the ability wheel:
    • "Spider Jab" - Use your waldoes to strike your target with a jab attack and deal 12 damage.
    • "Waldoes Guard" - Use your waldoes to cover yourself and block any incoming attack.
    • "Open Waldoes" - Open your waldoes.
    • "Close Waldoes" - Close your waldoes.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Enable Web Mode" - Enable your web mode to do web tricks. Web Swing with Right-Click, and Web Zip with Left-Click.
    • "Web Zip" - Attach a web to a block within 30 blocks in the direction you are looking to be pulled towards it. This ability costs 2 WF when used (even if your target is out of range).
    • "Web Swing" - Shoot a web line to swing between structures.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Change Web-Type" - Switch through all of your available web types in your 4th Slot.
    • "Web Shot" - Fire off a high velocity ball of webs which can deal 2 damage when a target is hit. This ability costs 5 WF and has a cooldown of 1/4 seconds.
    • "Impact Web Blast" - Fire off a larger ball of webs which can deal 6 damage when a target is hit, and will trap them in a cobweb. This ability costs 20 WF and has a cooldown of 2 seconds.
    • "Concussion Web Blast" - Fire off a ball of webs which can deal 1 damage when a target is hit, and hot with a Knockback of 3. This ability costs 15 WF and has a cooldown of 2 seconds.
    • "Shock Web Blast" - Fire off a ball of webs enhanced by electricity which can deal 2 damage when a target is hit, and applies the Shock effect for 4 seconds on the target that is hit. This ability costs 25 WF and has a cooldown of 2 seconds.
    • "Web Grenade" - Fire off a large ball of condensed webs which can deal 6 damage when a target is hit, and creates a non-destructive explosion when hit. This ability costs 50 WF and has a cooldown of 3 seconds.

Related Information:

  • This Suits's recipe becomes unlocked after crafting the Iron Spider Model I suit.
